mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate suggests labor market weakness, which may lead to negative equity returns as economic growth falters.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 60% of the time when UNRATE increases by 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low and payroll employment is rising, it indicates a strong labor market, which is positive for equity returns as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time when UNRATE is low and PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPI) in a low-interest-rate environment may lead to inflation concerns, prompting the Fed to tighten monetary policy, which could negatively impact equity markets.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time when CPI increases by 0.5% during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which is positive for corporate earnings and equity prices.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests supply-side weakness, which may lead to negative equity returns as corporate earnings could be impacted.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >1 point in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time when INDPRO decreases by 1 point.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is high and the unemployment rate is low, it may indicate a tight labor market and potential monetary policy tightening, which could negatively impact equity markets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time when FEDFUNDS is high and UNRATE is low.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) during an economic recovery suggests improving consumer confidence and demand, which is positive for equity markets.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 50% of the time when HOUST increases by 5% during early-cycle recovery.
